lede: West Bengal and CPCB rules exist for clay idols, a ban on PoP and thermocol in guidance, and controlled immersion. Whether BKS follows them is not verified.

items.title: What the rules say
items.body: CPCB 2020 immersion guidelines and West Bengal 2018 immersion rules plus festival SOPs: natural clay, no PoP, no thermocol, no single-use plastic, scheduled immersion, waste removed.

items.title: Could explore
items.body: Clay-only image, plastic-light décor, waste stations, modest lighting, community cleanup — if a physical Puja is approved.
